summary: SEALSQ Corp (NASDAQ: LAES) filed a Form 6-K on July 8, 2026, reporting preliminary unaudited financial results for H1 2026 (six months ended June 30, 2026). H1 2026 revenue was approximately $11 million (120% YoY growth), with Q2 2026 revenue of ~$7 million. Cash and short-term investments stood at ~$495 million. Revenue growth was driven by increased demand for Vault-IC secure elements, contributions from the IC ALPS SAS acquisition (Aug 2025), and growth in PKI subscriptions and the Quantix Edge Security design center. The filing also notes progress on the QS7001 Post-Quantum Secure Element certifications and the SEALQuantum Fund ($200M target, $60M+ allocated). This is a routine earnings update, not a special situation.
